messages:
jamie: FYI customer reports refund request routed to legacy credit API and they got credited instead of a refund. ticket #4872. attaching payload below.

sasha: Can you paste the original request and any router logs?

jamie: here's the request they sent (redacted payment ids):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/invoke \\n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' \\n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\n  -d '{\"customer_id\":\"cus_123\", \"amount\": \"100.00\", \"currency\": \"USD\", \"note\": \"customer requests refund for order #1001\"}'
```
No explicit intent field, amount is a string.

router-bot: route_decision: chosen=legacy_credit_api confidence=0.61 fallback=refund_api confidence=0.39 match_keys=[amount,customer_id] matched_signatures=[credit_note_v1,refund_v2] reason='amount:string match preferred'

ana: quick look — this smells like a selector-weighting issue. refund_v2 expects amount:number in its schema; the legacy credit tool still accepts amount:string. Our heuristic currently boosts tools that match numeric-like fields even when types differ. That made credit_note_v1 win here. Repro steps: set router.debug=true and replay request.

jamie: got it. customer also sent payment_intent_id but I don't see that in the payload above — would that have helped?

ana: payment_intent_id would help if present. In this case legacy tool signature includes amount:string and shorter signature length so it scored higher under current heuristics. TL;DR: type-coercion + amount-weighting edge-case.

ana: Proposed immediate mitigations: 1) support team can send a header `X-Tool-Hint: refund_api` or include \"tool_hint\": \"refund_api\" in the payload as a temporary workaround. 2) engineering fix: lower amount-type weight from 0.25 -> 0.1 and add a rule to prefer tools whose name contains refund/return when NL text includes refund/return. I'll open a PR to eng-runtime and put a canary.

sasha: i'll reply to the customer with the header workaround now. any ETA on the patch?

ana: will open PR and run unit + local router simulation. Canary ETA ~3h, full rollout 24h if tests and canary look good. PR will include a regression test for amount as string vs number.

jamie: extra note — i reproduced locally by toggling `router.debug=true` and got the same chosen tool. log snippet: `router.choose: chosen=legacy_credit_api (0.61) score_breakdown={schema_match:0.4, name_match:0.05, amount_bias:0.16}`. adding to ticket.

router-bot: Canary deploy scheduled: canary/route-fix -> cluster-canary-3 at 2026-03-17T14:02:00Z.

sasha: customer confirmed workaround with `X-Tool-Hint: refund_api` invoked refund_api and refund completed. customer happy. marking as resolved pending rollback if canary fails. :white_check_mark:

ana: PR #789 opened -> merged to canary. I'll monitor for 6h then promote. Postmortem + action items to follow (reduce numeric bias, add name-signal override, add telemetry for amount-type mismatches).

jamie: thanks everyone — closing thread once canary promoted. added notes to ticket #4872."
